search.desc: Tsalani kumbe vulani rito kutani mi kuma tinhlamuselo ta rona hinkwato, swikombiso, xifaniso ni masungulo ya rona.
search.s1: Tsalani rito ebokisini ro lava, kumbe tlhutani mic kutani mi ri vula.
search.s3: Tlhutani 'Xifaniso' ehansi ka nhlamuselo leswaku mi vona xifaniso xa yona.
search.s4: Eku heteleleni: laha rito ri humaka kona, kutani ku landzela batani ya 'Gad it!'.
listen.s1: Etlhelo ka rito, tlhutani xifaniso xa xipikara.
save.title: Buku ya n'wina ya marito yi tata hi yoxe
save.desc: Rito rin'wana ni rin'wana leri mi ri lavisisaka ri hlayisiwa ebukwini ya n'wina ya marito hi ku tisungulela.
save.s1: Rito rin'wana ni rin'wana leri mi ri lavisisaka ri tihlayisa hi roxe, a ku na nchumu wo tlhuta.
save.s2: Leswaku mi vona marito ya n'wina, pfulani 'Buku ya marito' eka menyu ya le henhla.
save.s3: Marito ya n'wina hinkwawo ma kwalaho, naswona eka tipulani leti hakeriwaka ma tirha ni handle ka Internet.
save.s4: Eka Basic, buku ya mahala ya marito yi hlayisa ku fika eka marito ya 30.
context.title: Nhlamuselo leyi faneleke eka xivulwa xa n'wina
context.desc: Engetelani xivulwa laha rito ri humelelaka kona kutani mi kuma nhlamuselo yin'we leyi fambelanaka na xona.
context.s1: Tsalani rito, kutani exivandleni lexi nga ehansi ka rona, tsalani xivulwa laha ri humelelaka kona.
context.s2: Gadit yi mi nyika nhlamuselo yin'we leyi fambelanaka ni xivulwa xexo.
context.s3: Xivandla lexi fanaka xi le hansi ka bara yo lava eka pheji rin'wana ni rin'wana ra rito.
wordpage.title: Swo tala hi rito rin'wana ni rin'wana
wordpage.desc: Tsala xivulwa xa wena, kuma swikombiso swin'wana kutani u fungha rito tanihi leri twisisiweke.
wordpage.s1: Ehansi ka nhlamuselo, tlhutani 'Write a sentence of your own and check you understood'.
wordpage.s2: Tsala kumbe vula xivulwa xa n'wina, tlhutani 'Kambela xivulwa' kutani mi kuma nhlamulo kolaho.
wordpage.s3: Eka tipulani leti hakeriwaka, '+ Swivulwa swin'wana swa xikombiso' swi engetela swikombiso swinharhu leswintshwa.
wordpage.s4: Eku heteleleni, tlhutani 'Gad it!' kutani rito ri funghiwa tanihi leri twisisiweke ebukwini ya marito.
extras.title: Swivutiso hi rito
extras.desc: Eka tipulani leti hakeriwaka: marito lama kanetanaka, marito lama fanaka, ndyangu wa rito, swihoxo leswi tolovelekeke ni ndlela yo ri tsundzuka.
extras.s1: Endzhaku ka 'Gad it!', 'Mi ni xivutiso hi rito leri?' yi nyika swivutiso swa ntlhanu.
extras.s2: Tlhutani xivutiso kutani nhlamulo yi pfuleka ehansi ka xona.
kids.title: Mode ya Vana
kids.desc: Switch yin'we eka bara ya le henhla yi hlamusela rito rin'wana ni rin'wana hi ndlela leyi munhu a nga ri hlamuselaka n'wana.
kids.s1: Eka Family, pfulani switch ya 'Vana' etlhelo ka logo.
kids.s2: Sweswi nhlamuselo yin'wana ni yin'wana yi tsaleriwa n'wana.
kids.s3: Loko swi pfurile, menyu yi kombisa 'Ntirho wa le kaya' ematshan'weni ya 'Titolovete'.
kids.s4: Eka xitirhisiwa lexi avelaniwaka, pfulani 'Shared kids screen' eka My family, kutani n'wana un'wana ni un'wana a tlhuta xifaniso xa yena.
install.desc: Engetelani Gadit eka home screen ya n'wina eka iPhone, kumbe mi yi nghenisa eka Android.
install.s1: Eka iPhone, pfulani gadit.app eka Safari kutani mi tlhuta batani ya Avelana.
install.s2: Kokani ehansi, hlawulani 'Add to Home Screen' kutani mi tlhuta 'Add'.
install.s3: Eka Android, nghenisani app ya Gadit ku suka eka Google Play, kumbe mi tlhuta 'Nghenisa' eka Chrome.
install.s4: Sweswi Gadit yi pfuleka ku suka eka icon ya yona, ku fana ni app yin'wana ni yin'wana.
addchild.title: Engetela xirho xa ndyangu
addchild.desc: Hlawulani xiave, vito ni muvala, ku fika eka vana va 5 eka Family.
addchild.s1: Eka My family, eka tab ya Family, tlhutani 'Engetela xirho xa ndyangu'.
addchild.s2: Hlawulani xiave: Tatana, Manana, N'wana wa jaha kumbe N'wana wa nhwanyana.
addchild.s3: Tsalani vito, hlawulani muvala, engetelani malembe loko mi swi lava, kutani mi tlhuta 'Engetela endyangwini'.
addchild.s4: Loko vito se ri ri endyangwini, mi nga tlhela mi hlanganisa phurofayili yoleyo kutani mi hlayisa marito ya yona.
pair.desc: Hlanganisani xitirhisiwa xa n'wana hi khodi ya QR kumbe khodi ya 6 ya tidijiti.
pair.s1: Eka tab ya Family, tlhutani 'Hlanganisa xitirhisiwa' eka khadi ya n'wana.
pair.s2: Skenani khodi ya QR hi xitirhisiwa xa n'wana, kumbe mi pfula gadit.app/join koloko kutani mi tsala khodi.
pair.s3: Eka iPhone, pfulani Gadit ku suka eka icon ya home screen kutani mi tlhuta 'Nghenisa khodi'.
pair.s4: Tsalani tidijiti ta 6, kutani n'wana loyi a tlhela a hlanganisiwa u tlhela a kuma marito ya yena hinkwawo.
dash.s1: Pfulani 'My family' eka menyu ya avatar, kutani tab ya Kaya yi katsakanya swa ndyangu.
dash.s2: N'wana un'wana ni un'wana u na khadi leri nga ni marito, masiku hi ku landzelelana, xiyimo ni marito ya sweswinyana.
dash.s3: Nxaxamelo wa ndyangu wu kombisa leswaku un'wana ni un'wana wa n'wina u lavisise marito mangani.
dash.s4: 'Ku lavisisa ka sweswinyana' ku longoloxa rito rin'wana ni rin'wana leri vana va ri lavisiseke, ro sungula hi lerintshwa.
alerts.title: Switsundzuxo hi vana va n'wina
alerts.desc: Kumani mahungu hi marito, switsariwa, tidyondzo, mintlangu, ku hlaya ni tinyimpi.
alerts.s1: Eka My family, eka Swiyimiso, pfulani 'Ndzi byela leswi vana va mina va swi endlaka eka Gadit'.
alerts.s2: Hlawulani 'Hinkwaswo, hi nkarhi wolowo' kumbe 'Nkatsakanyo wa siku na siku'.
alerts.s3: Hlawulani leswi mi lavaka ku twiswa hi swona, kutani mi pfula switsundzuxo kan'we eka xitirhisiwa xin'wana ni xin'wana.
alerts.s4: Switsundzuxo swi fika hi email, naswona laha swi kotekaka swi tlhela swi fika tanihi banner eka riqingho.
homework.title: Ntirho wa le kaya
homework.desc: Eka vana va Family: engetelani ntirho wa le kaya hi xifaniso kumbe hi ku namarheta, kutani mi wu titoloveta.
homework.s1: Eka 'Ntirho wa le kaya', tlhutani Teka xifaniso, Layicha kumbe Namarheta leswaku mi engetela ntirho wa le kaya wa vusiku lebyi.
homework.s2: Kambelani marito, hlawulani leswaku i yini ni leswaku xikambelo i rini, kutani mi tlhuta Hlayisa.
homework.s3: Ntirho wa le kaya wu tshama ehansi ka 'Leswi faneleke ku endliwa', etlhelo ka ku dyondza marito, ku hlaya ni ku tilulamisela xikambelo.
homework.s4: 'Ku dyondza marito' ku na xitsariwa, yingisela kutani u hlawula, ntlangu wa swifaniso ni tidyondzo ta ririmi.
ranks.title: Swiyimo, masiku hi ku landzelelana ni nxaxamelo wa ndyangu
ranks.desc: Rito rin'wana ni rin'wana lerintshwa ri mi yisa ekusuhi ni xiyimo lexi landzelaka, naswona ku titoloveta loku hetiweke ku pfula ti-skin letintshwa.
ranks.s1: Tlhutani badge ya xiyimo eka bara ya le henhla leswaku mi vona swiyimo swa n'wina.
ranks.s2: Rito rin'wana ni rin'wana lerintshwa ebukwini ya n'wina ri mi tlakusela eswiyimweni.
ranks.s3: Vana va vona masiku hi ku landzelelana, xikongomelo xa vhiki ni xiyimo xa vona, naswona swiyimo swa le henhla swi pfula mivonakalo leyintshwa.
ranks.s4: Nxaxamelo wa ndyangu eka My family wu kombisa loyi a lavisiseke marito yo tala.
reader.desc: Tekani xifaniso, namarhetani kumbe layichani xitsariwa, tlhutani rito rihi ni rihi, kutani mi kambela leswaku ma twisisa.
reader.s1: Eka 'Rito rin'wana ni rin'wana', namarhetani xitsariwa, tekani xifaniso xa pheji, layichani xifaniso kumbe PDF, kumbe mi avelana xikirini xa n'wina.
reader.s2: 'Marito ya nkoka eka xitsariwa lexi' yi kombisa marito lama faneleke ku dyondziwa ku sungula.
reader.s3: Tlhutani rito rihi ni rihi leswaku mi vona nhlamuselo ya rona, naswona rito rin'wana ni rin'wana leri mi ri pfulaka ri hundzuka ra rihlaza.
reader.s4: Eku heteleleni, xikambelo xa ku hlaya xi vutisa leswaku marito ma vula yini eka xitsariwa.
say.title: Xi vule hi ririmi rin'wana
say.desc: Tsalani xivulwa, hlawulani ririmi, xi yingiseleni kutani mi titoloveta ku xi vula.
say.s1: Eka 'Swi vule', tsalani kumbe rekhoda xivulwa kutani mi hlawula ririmi leri mi lavaka ku xi yingisela hi rona.
say.s2: Tlhutani 'Swi vule' kutani mi yingisela leswaku xi twala njhani kahle.
say.s3: Endzhaku ka sweswo, tlhutani 'Titoloveteni ku xi vula' kutani mi xi vula hi rito.
say.s4: Mi kuma ku fika eka tinyeleti ta ntlhanu, ni xitsundzuxo loko xi nga si twala kahle.
practice.title: Titolovete
practice.desc: Eka vanhu lavakulu eka Individual na Family: ku hlaya, ku tilulamisela xikambelo, xitsariwa ni ririmi.
practice.s1: Pfulani 'Titolovete' eka menyu ya le henhla.
practice.s2: Hlawulani xin'we eka mune: ku hlaya, xikambelo, xitsariwa kumbe ririmi.
practice.s3: Eka xikambelo, namarhetani nxaxamelo wa marito kutani mi titoloveta ku fika siku rero.
practice.s4: Eka xitsariwa mi yingisela rito, mi ri tsala kutani mi vona mapela lama lulameke.
games.title: Mintlangu ya marito
games.desc: Mintlangu eka marito ya le bukwini ya n'wina ya marito, ni yin'wana yo tala.
games.s1: Pfulani 'Tlanga' eka menyu ya le henhla.
games.s2: 'Ku suka ebukwini ya marito' ku tlangeriwa eka marito lawa mi ma lavisiseke.
games.s3: Ehansi ku na mintlangu yin'wana hi masungulo ya marito, marito lama kongomeke ni xivumbeko xa marito.
games.s4: Ntlangu wun'wana ni wun'wana lowu hetiweke wu mi tshinetela eka skin leyintshwa.
duel.title: Ntlangu wa Marito
duel.desc: Swivutiso leswi fanaka ku lwisana ni ndyangu, munghana kumbe Word Bot.
duel.s2: Tlanganani eka xitirhisiwa lexi, rhambanani hi khodi kumbe link, nghenani hi khodi, kumbe mi tlanga na Word Bot.
duel.s3: Leswaku mi tlanga ni munhu loyi a nga online sweswi, mutswari u pfula 'Ntlangu wa Marito ni vana van'wana' eka Swiyimiso.
duel.s4: Loyi a lulameke naswona a hatlaka wa hlula, naswona tafula ra ku hlula ri hlayisa mintlhontlho.
account.s1: Pfulani 'Akhawunti' eka menyu ya avatar leswaku mi vona pulani ya n'wina.
account.s2: Eka Basic, tlhutani 'Yisa eka Family' kumbe 'Yisa eka Individual'.
account.s4: Eka pulani leyi hakeriwaka, 'Lawula ku hakela' na 'Cinca pulani' swi lawula leswi saleke.
cancel.title: Khansela, yimisa kumbe tima ku pfuxetiwa
cancel.desc: Leswi humelelaka loko mi khansela, ni tindlela to olova endleleni.
cancel.s1: Eka Akhawunti, tlhutani 'Cancel subscription' kutani mi hlawula xivangelo loko mi swi lava.
cancel.s2: Eka pulani ya n'hweti na n'hweti, mi nga yi yimisa ku ringana n'hweti yin'we ematshan'weni yo khansela, handle ko hakela.
cancel.s3: Eka nkarhi wa mahala wa ringo, xivangelo xa 'I didn't want an automatic charge' xi mi pfumelela ku tima ntsena ku pfuxetiwa.
cancel.s4: Loko mi cinca mianakanyo, tlhutani 'Ndzi khanselile hi xihoxo, hlayisani ku xava'.
